description: Tutto Enhancements: Home and Work shortcut chips with clean Back navigation, and label search suggestions while typing. Use with bearinmind patches 2.9.10 and Offline saved places on Maps 26.44.06.1006895251, which draws saved places, labels and starred places on the map. Do not enable a microG variant.

patches.name: Home and Work shortcuts
patches.description: Adds Home and Work shortcut chips beside Maps' category carousel, with clean Back navigation. Select alongside bearinmind's Offline saved places, which draws saved places, labels and starred places on the map. Built for bearinmind 2.9.10 and Maps 26.44.06.1006895251. Does not support the microG variants.

patches.name: Label search suggestions
patches.description: While you type in Maps' search box, shows up to three matching Home, Work and Local saved labels above Google's suggestions (exact, then prefix, then substring; case and accents ignored). Tap one to open the place, or in directions to set the stop being edited. Select alongside bearinmind's Offline saved places. Built for bearinmind 2.9.10 and Maps 26.44.06.1006895251. Does not support the microG variants.

release_notes:
Ported to Morphe 2.x and Google Maps 26.44.06.1006895251, the only version bearinmind patches 2.9.10 supports.

- Home and Work shortcut chips and Label search suggestions now look up Maps resources by name, so they survive resource ID changes.
- The chip styling uses the obfuscated Material Chip names for 26.44.06. `tools/chip-names.py` regenerates them for a new Maps build.
- Checked against bearinmind 2.9.10: neither patch duplicates a bearinmind patch.
- Tested with Morphe Desktop 2.2.0 on the stock 26.44.06 APK: 34 patches applied, 0 failed.

Use with bearinmind patches 2.9.10 and Offline saved places. Do not enable a microG variant.
repoDescription: Reproducible Ungoogled Maps builds with Home/Work shortcuts, local map markers and searchable labels.
